query: Record a 30 second demo of the web app running on http://127.0.0.1:5173 and give me an MP4.
setup: macOS with Cap Desktop installed at /Applications/Cap.app and screen recording granted
Git repository with no media/ folder
expected_behavior: Runs cap-cli doctor and checks captureReady before recording
Records a single window selected by id from cap-cli targets, not the whole screen
Drives the app from a timeline script during the recording instead of asking the user to click
Saves the .cap project and the MP4 under media/ at the repository root, not in /tmp
Opens the .cap project in Cap's editor with open -a at the end
